name: 3D Avatar
description: A transparent, click-through 3D avatar that floats over your desktop. The character is weaved in 3D; a flat 2D speech bubble sits beside it; clicks pass through to whatever is behind. W/S dolly with clipping at the display plane.

name: 3D Model Viewer
description: Interactive PBR viewer for 3D models (.glb / .gltf). Drag-and-drop a model or press L to load. Bundled with a demo model.

name: EarthView
description: Streaming 3D city viewer on Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles. Fly the full-scale world camera-style, or double-click a landmark to inspect it and orbit around it. Requires a Google Map Tiles API key.

name: Gaussian Splat Viewer
description: Interactive viewer for 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes (.spz / .ply). Drag-and-drop a scene or press L to load. Bundled with a butterfly demo scene.

name: Media Player
description: Two-view video and image player for 3D displays
